title: Microsoft.Extensions.Configuration
description: A flexible configuration system for .NET supporting JSON, XML, INI, and environment variables.

data.text: Microsoft.Extensions.Configuration provides a flexible configuration system for .NET. It supports multiple configuration providers including JSON files, XML, INI, environment variables, command-line arguments, and Azure Key Vault.

data.title: Loading Configuration
data.content: Build a configuration in a console app.

terms.definition: Builds a configuration from multiple providers.
The main interface for accessing configuration values.

data.title: Key Takeaways
data.takeaway: Microsoft.Extensions.Configuration centralizes app settings in a flexible way.
